scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml up -d --wait mongo redis
scripts.infra:stop: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml stop mongo redis

scripts.check:public-client: tsc integrations/public-api/client.ts --noEmit --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --lib ES2022,DOM --skipLibCheck
